name: outreach-squad
description: Daily outbound engine: finds leads, runs sequences, handles replies, and files a digest on the board every day. Simple mode by default, upgrades to Advanced when signals stack.
author: pancake-official

workflows.summary: Find ICP-matched leads and run a sequenced multi-touch outreach.

icp.description: Ideal customer profile: role / industry / size / trigger event.
icp.example: Head of Sales at 20-100p B2B SaaS that just raised a seed

volume.description: Number of leads to contact in this campaign.

workflows.outcome: N leads contacted via sequenced touches, replies triaged, results filed on the board.

workflows.summary: Source and enrich ICP-matched leads (signal-first, ICP-search fallback).

icp.description: Ideal customer profile to match leads against.
icp.example: Head of Sales at 20-100p B2B SaaS that just raised a seed

count.description: Number of leads to source and enrich.

workflows.outcome: A list of enriched, ICP-qualified leads appended to the pipeline ledger and filed on the board.

workflows.summary: Sweep active channels and respond to inbound replies with the qualify-first framework.
workflows.outcome: Every new reply handled (Q1→Q2→meeting), lead rows updated, closed rows moved.

workflows.summary: Compute 7-day pipeline performance and log the week's learnings.
workflows.outcome: 7-day pipeline metrics + one Weekly Learning filed and summarized on the board.
